what: The private automation-liveness overlay's reader (onex-automation-liveness-check, node_automation_liveness_overlay_check_effect and its compute node at omnimarket dev d23f72b0). The landing controller's pre-merge liveness read runs the private checkout's installed copy of this reader; its tests run the reader from these files, so a change of the reader's output or flags that the read does not follow fails here and not on a live tick. Pydantic, pyyaml and omnibase-core only; CI fetches exactly these paths at this commit.
